components.name: Accordion
components.summary: A disclosure stack for FAQs, settings groups, and statement breakdowns.

components.name: Avatar
components.summary: A circular person avatar (account holder, shared-ledger member) with an initials fallback when the image is missing.

components.name: Badge
components.summary: Small pill for status, category, and counts — `default` is oxblood brand fill, `secondary` the neutral workhorse, and `dot`/`pulse` turn it into a live status indicator.

props.name: size
props.description:
Type/padding scale. `default` is the historical 2px/8px pill; `sm` is the
denser chip for table cells and dense stat rows.

props.name: dot
props.description:
Render a leading status dot, tinted from the variant. The dot is
`aria-hidden` — the label carries the meaning, so a label is required
(or an explicit `aria-label` if you render a dot with no text).

props.name: pulse
props.description:
Gently pulse the status dot to draw attention to a live/changing state.
Implies `dot`. Frozen under `prefers-reduced-motion`.

components.name: Button
components.summary: Cashflow's action button — solid oxblood `primary` for the main CTA, neutral variants for the rest, tinted `destructive` for deletes.

props.name: variant
props.description: Visual treatment. Default solid oxblood.

props.name: size
props.description: Control height. `icon` is a 40×40 square.

components.name: Card
components.summary: The default raised surface — white card, hairline border, light shadow, rounded-lg. Everything sits in one. Configurable enough that you should never hand-roll a panel/section div.

props.name: variant
props.description: Surface treatment. Defaults to the raised bordered card.

props.name: padding
props.description: Padding density off the `--space-*` ladder. Defaults to `--space-5` (20px).

props.name: radius
props.description: Corner radius off the `--radius-*` ladder. Defaults to `--radius-lg`.

components.name: Icon
components.summary: Stroke glyph from the built-in registry — lucide-style, renders in `currentColor`, sized by the `size` prop.

props.name: name
props.description: Which glyph to render.

props.name: size
props.description: Edge length in px (square). Default 20.

props.name: strokeWidth
props.description: Stroke weight. Default 2.

props.name: brand
props.description: Render a `brand:` glyph in its official color instead of `currentColor`. No-op on stroke glyphs.

props.name: title
props.description:
Accessible label. When set, the icon is exposed to assistive tech as an
image with this name; when omitted, the icon is `aria-hidden` (decorative).

components.name: Kbd
components.summary: A keycap for documenting shortcuts in menus, tooltips, and command hints.

components.name: Link
components.summary: An inline anchor for body copy and table cells. Defaults to the oxblood-leaning `--text-link`; underline appears on hover only.

components.name: Progress
components.summary: A determinate bar for budgets, savings goals, import progress, and playback. Use `tone` to signal state (e.g. `danger` when a category is over budget), `valueText` when a percentage is the wrong readout, and `segments` for a stacked bar.

props.name: valueText
props.description: Free-form readout replacing the generated percent, e.g. "1:23 / 4:56".

props.name: segments
props.description:
Stacked bands, rendered left to right. Supersedes `value` and
`indeterminate`. Values are percentages of the track; if they sum past 100
every band is scaled down proportionally so the stack still fills exactly
one track (nothing is clipped or dropped) and the track gets
`data-overflow="true"`.

components.name: Separator
components.summary: A hairline rule to separate sections, list rows, or inline metadata.

components.name: Spinner
components.summary: An indeterminate loading ring for buttons, inline fetches, and empty panels. Inside a Button it inherits the label color via `tone="current"`.

components.name: Text
components.summary: The single typography primitive — use it for every piece of text instead of bare tags so the type scale and token colors stay consistent. `variant` sets the scale step and a default tag; `as` overrides the tag.

components.name: ChartFrame
components.summary: ChartFrame component

props.name: title
props.description: Header heading. Omit (with subtitle and actions) to drop the header row.

props.name: subtitle
props.description: Secondary line under the title.

props.name: actions
props.description: Right-aligned header controls — a period selector, a menu, a legend toggle.

props.name: footer
props.description: Legend or source note rendered under the plot.

props.name: height
props.description: Plot height in px, or `'auto'` to derive it from `rowCount`. Default 280.

props.name: rowCount
props.description: Rows in the chart. Drives the height when `height="auto"`. Default 0.

props.name: rowHeight
props.description: Px per row in `'auto'` mode. Default 32.

props.name: minHeight
props.description: Floor for the resolved height. Default 200.

props.name: maxHeight
props.description: Ceiling for the resolved height. Default 560.

props.name: padding
props.description: Shell padding scale. `'none'` lets the plot bleed to the card edge.

components.name: DataTable
components.summary: DataTable component

props.name: columns
props.description: Column definitions, left to right.

props.name: rows
props.description: The rows to render, in the order they should appear.

props.name: getRowKey
props.description:
Stable React key per row. Required on purpose: keying by array index
silently corrupts state when rows are sorted, filtered or paginated.

props.name: sort
props.description: Controlled sort state, or `null`/omitted for unsorted.

props.name: onSortChange
props.description: Called with the next sort state when a sort button is activated.

props.name: empty
props.description: Shown in a full-width cell when `rows` is empty and not loading.

props.name: loading
props.description: Replace the body with shimmering `Skeleton` rows.

props.name: loadingRows
props.description: How many skeleton rows to render while `loading`. Default 4.

props.name: maxHeight
props.description: Max height of the scroll region; the head stays sticky above it.

props.name: containerClassName
props.description: Class for the scroll container (the element `maxHeight` constrains).

components.name: LetterAvatar
components.summary: LetterAvatar component

components.name: StatCard
components.summary: StatCard component

props.name: delta
props.description: Signed string, e.g. "+12%" or "-$340".

props.name: bare
props.description: Drop the card shell (border, background, elevation), keep the padding.

components.name: StatGrid
components.summary: StatGrid component

props.name: columns
props.description: Track count, or `'auto'` for a responsive auto-fit grid. Default `'auto'`.

props.name: minItemWidth
props.description: Minimum auto-fit track width — a number is px. Only used when `columns="auto"`. Default `180`.

props.name: gap
props.description: Gutter step. Ignored when `divided` (separators replace the gutter). Default `'md'`.

props.name: divided
props.description: Hairline separators between cells instead of gutters.

components.name: Table
components.summary: Table component

props.name: containerClassName
props.description: Class for the scroll container — the element `maxHeight` constrains.

components.name: Tabs
components.summary: Tabs component

props.name: overflow
props.description: `wrap` (default) preserves the multi-row wrap; `scroll` scrolls one row.

components.name: Alert
components.summary: Alert component

components.name: EmptyState
components.summary: EmptyState component

components.name: Skeleton
components.summary: Skeleton component

components.name: AccountCard
components.summary: A tile for a connected account in lists and the accounts grid.

components.name: AmountText
components.summary: The money-value primitive — use it for every currency figure instead of hand-coloring spans, so the green-in / oxblood-out convention stays consistent.

components.name: BudgetMeter
components.summary: A budget-vs-spend row for the budgets screen and category drill-downs. The bar self-colors: green under budget, amber near the limit, oxblood over.

components.name: CategoryBreakdown
components.summary: A card that ranks money by category as horizontal bars — the "net spend by category" tile.

props.name: iconOverrides
props.description: App-supplied category→icon map applied to every row's pill.

components.name: CategoryPill
components.summary: The category chip for transaction rows, filters, and budgets — icon + label with a per-category tint, drawn from a built-in icon set.

props.name: icon
props.description: Raw SVG geometry to render instead of any inferred/registry glyph.

props.name: iconName
props.description: A glyph from the icon registry by name — e.g. an app's stored category icon.

props.name: overrides
props.description: App-supplied category→icon map; wins over keyword inference.

components.name: ImportDropzone
components.summary: A drag-and-drop file intake surface — drop or click-to-browse. Defaults to the statement-import wording, but every piece of copy is a slot, so it works for receipts, exports or audio too.

props.name: accept
props.description: Accepted types, `accept`-attribute syntax. Enforced on drop as well as on browse.

props.name: multiple
props.description: Allow more than one file per selection.

props.name: maxSize
props.description: Hard byte ceiling, enforced on both intake paths. Omit for no limit.

props.name: onFile
props.description: Legacy singular callback — receives the first accepted file. Still supported.

props.name: onFiles
props.description: Receives every accepted file from a selection.

props.name: onError
props.description: Receives anything `accept`/`maxSize` turned away, from either intake path.

props.name: hint
props.defaultValue: CSV, OFX or QFX · up to 10MB
props.description: Secondary line under the primary copy.

props.name: label
props.description: Primary copy. Defaults to the statement-import wording.

props.name: children
props.description: Alias for `label`, for callers who prefer a child.

props.name: replaceLabel
props.description: The replace affordance shown next to the size once a file is chosen.

props.name: files
props.description: Controlled selection. Passing this (including `[]`/`null`) takes ownership.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Refuse both intake paths and dim the surface.

components.name: MoneyInput
components.summary: A currency amount field for adding/editing transactions and setting budgets. Pass `direction` + `onDirectionChange` to show the in/out toggle.

props.name: onValueChange
props.type: ((value: number | null, raw: string) => void) | undefined

components.name: PeriodSelector
components.summary: The date-range control every ledger view needs — preset periods with an optional custom range, in a compact popover.

props.name: custom
props.type: { from?: string | undefined; to?: string | undefined; } | undefined

props.name: onCustomChange
props.type: ((range: { from?: string | undefined; to?: string | undefined; }) => void) | undefined

props.name: presets
props.defaultValue:
[
  { value: 'this-month', label: 'This month' },
  { value: 'last-30', label: 'Last 30 days' },
  { value: 'this-quarter', label: 'This quarter' },
  { value: 'ytd', label: 'Year to date' },
  { value: 'this-year', label: 'This year' },
  { value: 'custom', label: 'Custom range' },
]

components.name: Sparkline
components.summary: A tiny trend line to sit beside a balance or inside a StatCard — green when the series rises, oxblood when it falls.

components.name: Checkbox
components.summary: A square checkbox for multi-select and form opt-ins (select transactions, terms). Use `indeterminate` on a header checkbox when some but not all rows are selected.

components.name: Combobox
components.summary: A searchable single-select for long option lists (assign a category, pick a payee, choose an account). For a handful of fixed options use NativeSelect.

props.name: name
props.description: Form control name — forwarded to the inner search `<input>`.

components.name: Field
components.summary: Field component

props.name: label
props.description: Label content. Omit for a field that is labelled some other way.

props.name: hint
props.description: Help text below the control. Hidden while `error` is set.

props.name: error
props.description: Error text below the control. Takes precedence over `hint`.

props.name: required
props.description: Marks the control `aria-required` and prints the label's `*`.

props.name: id
props.description: Control id. Generated when omitted (a child's own `id` wins over both).

components.name: Input
components.summary: Input component

props.name: leadingIcon
props.description: Node rendered inside the field's left edge. Decorative (`aria-hidden`).

props.name: trailingIcon
props.description: Node rendered inside the field's right edge. Decorative (`aria-hidden`).

props.name: clearable
props.description:
Render a clear button once the field has a value. It is a real `<button>`
with an accessible name, and is disabled (so out of the tab order) while
there is nothing to clear.

props.name: onClear
props.description: Called after the clear button is pressed. Controlled callers clear here.

props.name: clearLabel
props.description: Accessible name for the clear button.

components.name: Label
components.summary: Label component

components.name: NativeSelect
components.summary: NativeSelect component

components.name: RadioGroup
components.summary: A single-choice radio group for mutually-exclusive options (account type, statement period). Exported as `RadioGroup`.

components.name: Slider
components.summary: A single-value range control for budgets, thresholds, and filters (e.g. "alert when a transaction exceeds $X").

props.name: name
props.description: Form control name — forwarded to the inner `input[type=range]`.

components.name: Stepper
components.summary: A compact numeric input for small bounded quantities (split count, reminder days, statement months back).

components.name: Switch
components.summary: A pill toggle for on/off settings (notifications, auto-reconcile) — oxblood when on. Use over Checkbox for instant-apply settings, not form submission.

components.name: Textarea
components.summary: Textarea component

components.name: ToggleGroup
components.summary: A segmented control for switching between a few mutually-exclusive views (timeframe, chart type, account filter). For navigation between content panels prefer Tabs; use this for filters and settings.

components.name: UploadButton
components.summary: A file picker that looks like a Button — use it anywhere the app needs "pick a file" without hand-rolling a hidden `<input type="file">` and a proxy button.

props.name: accept
props.description: `accept` attribute for the input, e.g. `.csv,.ofx` or `audio/*`.

props.name: multiple
props.description: Allow picking more than one file.

props.name: maxSize
props.description: Hard byte ceiling; files over it are rejected instead of handed over.

props.name: onFiles
props.description: Called with the accepted files after every selection.

props.name: onError
props.description: Called with anything `accept`/`maxSize` turned away.

props.name: loading
props.description: Upload in flight — disables the control and sets `aria-busy`.

props.name: variant
props.description: Button treatment. Forwarded to `core/Button`.

props.name: size
props.description: Button size. Forwarded to `core/Button`.

props.name: icon
props.description: Leading node, swapped for a Spinner while `loading`. Icons are nodes — no icon dep.

props.name: loadingLabel
props.description: Label shown while `loading`; falls back to `children`.

props.name: inputRef
props.description: Escape hatch onto the hidden input (e.g. to clear it imperatively).

props.name: inputProps
props.description: Extra attributes for the hidden input.

components.name: Breadcrumb
components.summary: A path trail for nested views (Accounts › Amex Cobalt › Statements).

components.name: Pagination
components.summary: Page navigation for long transaction lists and search results.

components.name: ConfirmDialog
components.summary: The `window.confirm` replacement: an `alertdialog` with a title, one consequence line, and exactly two buttons. Reach for it before any destructive action (delete transaction, remove account, merge categories). Built on `Dialog`, so it inherits the focus trap, focus restore, dismiss stack and scroll lock.

props.name: confirmLabel
props.description: Confirm button text. Default `Confirm`.

props.name: cancelLabel
props.description: Cancel button text. Default `Cancel`.

props.name: tone
props.description:
`destructive` tints the confirm button and — deliberately — focuses Cancel
on open, so a reflexive Enter cannot delete anything.

props.name: onConfirm
props.description:
The action. May return a promise: the confirm button goes into a pending
state, both buttons disable, Escape and scrim clicks stop closing, and the
dialog stays open until it settles. A rejection is surfaced (see
`onError`), never swallowed, and the dialog stays open so the user can retry.

props.name: onClose
props.description: Called after a successful confirm, after cancel, and on Escape/scrim.

props.name: onError
props.description:
Handles a rejected/throwing `onConfirm`. Without it the error is re-thrown
during render so the nearest error boundary sees it rather than it
vanishing into a dead promise.

props.name: pending
props.description: Force the pending state (for a confirm driven by external state).

props.name: children
props.description: Extra detail rendered in the dialog body above the actions.

components.name: Dialog
components.summary: A modal for confirmations and short forms (delete transaction, edit category, add account). Keep the footer to one primary + one secondary Button. For a plain yes/no, reach for `ConfirmDialog` instead of hand-rolling the footer.

props.name: onClose
props.description: Fires on Escape (when topmost), scrim click, and nothing else.

props.name: closeOnEscape
props.description: `false` keeps the dialog open on Escape (it still swallows the key).

props.name: closeOnOverlayClick
props.description: `false` keeps the dialog open when the scrim is clicked.

props.name: portal
props.description: `false` renders in place in the React tree instead of a portal.

props.name: container
props.description: Portal target. Defaults to `document.body`.

props.name: lockScroll
props.description: `false` leaves `document.body` scrollable while the dialog is open.

props.name: initialFocus
props.description: Element to focus on open. Defaults to the first focusable child.

components.name: DropdownMenu
components.summary: A row/overflow action menu (the ⋯ on a transaction, account, or report). Use `danger` for delete and a `separator` to group destructive actions.

components.name: Toast
components.summary: A transient confirmation that floats bottom-right (transaction saved, statement imported, sync failed). Auto-dismiss after a few seconds; keep copy to one line.

props.name: role
props.description:
ARIA role. Derived from `variant` when omitted: `'alert'` for `error`,
`'status'` otherwise. Override to force one either way.

props.name: aria-live
props.description:
Live-region politeness. Derived from `variant` when omitted: `'assertive'`
for `error`, `'polite'` otherwise. Override to force one either way.

components.name: Toaster
components.summary: The host that actually shows toasts — mount `<Toaster />` once near the app root, then fire `toast()` from anywhere (event handlers, API layers, non-React code). Do not hand-roll a container: a hook that owns its own state gives every caller a separate queue, and toasts fired from a screen whose container nothing renders are silently dropped.

props.name: position
props.description: Corner or edge to pin the stack to. Default `'bottom-right'`.

props.name: max
props.description: Most toasts shown at once; the rest collapse into a `+N more` count. `0` shows all. Default `3`.

props.name: gap
props.description: Space between stacked toasts, in px. Default `10`.

props.name: duration
props.description: Default auto-dismiss in ms for toasts that don't set their own. Default `5000`.

props.name: container
props.description: Portal target. Defaults to `document.body`.

components.name: Tooltip
components.summary: A small hover/focus hint for icon buttons and truncated values (full merchant name, exact timestamp). Keep content to a few words — never essential-only info.
